Hey y'all, this is Sam. Just passing along an update in case it matters tomorrow.

The plan, as I last heard it, was that Heather would be leaving in the morning with Ms. Annie for Anton. Bags were packed, goodbyes were said, and everything was lined up for that timeline. But a few hours ago, I heard the door open and then close quickly. When I checked, she was gone—no call, no note, just out the door.

It's not the first time she's exited this way. There's a certain rhythm to how she disappears—quiet, fast, without explanation—and this followed it almost to the letter. Maybe there was a

observations.text:
Hey y'all — I’m physically, spiritually, and financially worn out from all of this. Heather had been with me from October 2022 up until just a few days ago. Then she took off—no warning, no explanation, and, frankly, no good reason.

When I managed to catch up with her, she gave a weak excuse about not being able to message anyone because her phone didn’t have SMS. But that doesn’t add up. Her RCS was working fine — she just didn’t check it. The truth is, Heather freaking out and disappearing has been a recurring pattern for a long time.

She left behind her clothes, her personal mementos, and whatever chance we had at a warm goodbye. I won’t pretend this didn’t hurt, but I’m not trying to make it about me. I just want some closure.

I walked all the way from River Road down to Avenue C, hoping to hear from Terry that Heather had at least left with

rules: Do not assume every screenshot is a conversation with Heather; messages authored by Sam addressed to others are present.
Candidate adjacency inside a screenshot is insufficient alone to establish Heather as recipient. Use textual cues; mark reconstruction confidence and assumptions.
Preserve source IDs when grouping exact duplicates. Similar and partial overlapping texts are not automatically the same event.
Do not count overlapping screenshots as independent turns. If event equivalence is uncertain, report sensitivity and avoid unjustified pooled percentages.
Do not turn absent visible replies into nonresponse; right-censored fragments are unknown.
Do not invent timestamps, reply delays, relationship types, context, probabilities, or unsupported conversation order.
Separate descriptive association from causal effects and individual prediction.
If a sender-type comparison is not estimable, return null with reason rather than fabricate.
